steps.title: Define Application Structure
steps.description: Configure directories and design the custom files for Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Prepare Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Set up Gradle configuration with AGP 8.3.2 and Target SDK 34 for compilation.

steps.title: Create Meta Properties
steps.description: Create app-meta.json to define identification properties for Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Design Custom Selectors
steps.description: Construct customized state drawables for tactile touch feedback on numeric, function, operator, and action buttons.

steps.title: Draft Calculator Keypad and Display Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml defining visual positioning for modern numeric, scientific, and functional interface keys.

steps.title: Configure App Themes and Text Styles
steps.description: Declare application styles and themes inside styles.xml to deliver dark-mode layout mechanics.

steps.title: Construct Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare the main activity class, launch intent filters, application permissions, and orientation settings inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Develop Mathematical Parser
steps.description: Develop custom Java recursive descent parser inside MainActivity.java supporting scientific operations (trigonometry, log, powers, percent).

steps.title: Hook UI Controls and Keystrokes
steps.description: Configure event listeners for numeric, floating-point, operator, parenthetical, functional, and layout backspace keys.

steps.title: Implement Real-time Computations
steps.description: Create immediate preview calculations updating on user typing actions inside calculations screen dynamically.

steps.title: Format Precision Output and Double Cleanups
steps.description: Write mathematical formatting methods to truncate long double decimals and eliminate redundant fraction notations.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute gradle assembler tasks to build application code, package APK resources and finalize process.
